title: A Researcher's Guide to Empirical Risk Minimization
summary: This guide provides a reference for high-probability regret bounds in empirical risk minimization (ERM). The presentation is modular: we begin with intuition and general proof strategies, then state broadly applicable guarantees under high-level conditions and provide tools for verifying them for specific losses and function classes.
